title: κ = 7.68257328708259e-4: shared-donor kernels after frozen PR317
body:
κ = 7.68257328708259e-4

This new source-bound conditional construction appends 90 shared-donor rank-one kernels to frozen PR317 and certifies exact `768257328708259/1000000000000000000`. It improves PR317's `7.6817007781759e-4` by `8.7250890669e-8` (about 0.01136%). The bit supplier binds; all earlier PR heads remain unchanged.

PR317 is vendored unchanged at `0a0b61a7f4601a96036af8bb6a6338c58f035d2e`. The new groups use alternate exact response bases and compatible common-frame donor sharing. Their actual F₂ prefix identities, source spans, dirty restoration, both reflected frame ledgers, and endpoint ranks are checked on the literal word. The resulting word has 384,591 records, 335,264 ADDs, 630 total kernel entries, 3,937 changed charts, 86,004 banks per stage and final SHA256 `668fab1ae01c69181cd7b182c0b66ca106aa3dd57f756b31d661bc7822b4cb05`.

Two complete fresh offline replays passed, including the release checkout, with the 170-file manifest unchanged (`98ea0dd2eef6691dd1c5f3c73a1a2f383a3c9523699fde9f5c7641df4f0e6c28`). The nested PR317 verifier runs first; the successor then checks all 12,070 global F₂ columns and 8,230 independent dirty helpers, exact changed projectors and bank assignments, the complete paid profile, both exact moment engines with fallback, the 47 strict assembly constraints, and the finite invoice. A distinct C++ audit independently recomputed the literal histogram, unit expansion, reflected census, selector charge, signed coefficient inventory and finite coefficient; all forward/inverse and omission controls pass.

The final literal paid profile contains 14,902,200 children with rank mass 65,919,600 and deficit 122,400. The invoice counts 389,016,851,400 selector calls, coefficient `25,380,271,118,580,401`, and a 94-bit payload within the retained 104-bit bound. See `research/p10-shared-kernels/README.md` and `PROOF.md` for the conditional boundary and reproduction command.

The repository's unrelated joint-matrix checks currently fail on upstream main because `research/joint-dual/SOURCE.json` pins an old Makefile digest; the same failure reproduces on an unchanged checkout before this PR's files are present. The package-specific workflow runs the complete successor verifier.

Prepared for eumemic with substantial **OpenAI Codex assistance**. The package retains PR317 and all inherited notices, attributions and scope disclosures. This PR claims only the new p10 shared-donor selection and its complete source-bound admission; it is not a new unconditional multiplication theorem or runtime benchmark.
